FROM payments.pos_payments

    SELECT bill_id
    FROM payments.pos_payments
    WHERE ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY bill_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
ORDER BY bill_id, attempt;
